scope: Cross-language Directus SDK HTTP error normalization
contract: Python and TypeScript expose stable ValidationError, AuthenticationError, ForbiddenError, NotFoundError, and KokonutError classes with status codes and response context; network failures without an HTTP response remain native transport errors.

validation.python: python3 -m pytest tests/test_sdk.py tests/test_sdk_schema_parity.py tests/test_sdk_method_parity.py -q — 94 passed
validation.javascript: cd sdk/javascript && npm test -- --run — 45 passed; includes actual pinned-SDK HTTP 403 transport using stubbed fetch
validation.typescript: cd sdk/javascript && npm run build — passed
validation.ruff: python3 -m ruff check sdk/python/kokonut/client.py tests/test_sdk.py — passed

boundaries: Synthetic error envelopes and stubbed fetch were used; no network request, database, provider, or credential was accessed.
This verifies SDK error normalization only; it does not establish live Directus behavior, authorization, or tenant isolation.
